title: CM Punk vs. Drew McIntyre: a personal war
summary: Injury, taunts and repeated interference make Punk and McIntyre’s rivalry intensely personal. Their first major singles matches lead to Hell in a Cell.

chapters.title: McIntyre wins with Rollins as referee
chapters.context: Punk’s conflict with special referee Seth Rollins helps McIntyre capitalize.

chapters.title: Punk wins inside Hell in a Cell
chapters.context: The Cell provides the decisive payoff to this selected 2024 chapter.
